scope: Dataset RAW_DATA.zip and accompanying READ_ME.pdf linked by the repository dataset record. Associated journal article is separate.

modifications: UTF-16 tab-separated source measurements parsed into JSON records grouped by contiguous experimental-procedure labels.
Blank separators retained by line number; numeric values, order and local phase time/strain origins preserved.
Browser projection converts hours to seconds, percent to dimensionless strain, MPa to Pa, degrees Celsius to kelvin and ml to cubic metres.
